fields.Name: T313 - Scheduling Jobs Status and Type Filter
fields.Description: Tests the mj-filter-popover + mj-filter-panel wiring and applyFilters status/type equality branch on the custom card grid — distinct from the generic grid's column/status filter code.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Jobs' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Open the filter popover (the funnel/'Filters' control in the header/toolbar). Verify the filter panel renders with a 'Status' dropdown (options like Active, Paused, Disabled, Pending, Expired) and a 'Type' dropdown. Pick a Status value and confirm the job card grid narrows to matching jobs OR shows a 'No jobs match your search and filters' no-results state, and that the active-filter indicator/count appears. Using 'Reset filters' / clear-all to restore the list is a bonus. Seeing the filter panel drive the grid is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The filter popover opens and shows Status and Type dropdown fields
Selecting a Status narrows the card grid to matches OR shows a no-results empty state, and an active-filter count/indicator appears
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
